name: datasetDetail.py
summary: Django REST Framework serializer providing detailed JSON representation of the Dataset model with nested dataset table serialization.
purpose: Decouples the internal Dataset domain model from external API contracts, enabling detailed data exposure—including related table structures—while centralizing validation and transformation logic for dataset detail endpoints.
responsibilities: Serialize Dataset model instances into detailed JSON representations
Deserialize and validate incoming request payloads for Dataset mutations
Compose nested DatasetTableSerializer to embed related table metadata within dataset detail responses
Enforce field-level and object-level validation rules for dataset operations
Act as the boundary between the persistence layer (Dataset model) and the presentation layer (dataset views)
inputs: Incoming JSON payload for create/update operations
outputs: Validated Python dictionaries for model write operations
Nested JSON payload containing Dataset fields and associated DatasetTable data
architecture_notes: Implements the Serializer pattern from Django REST Framework, serving as a dedicated Data Transfer Object (DTO) for detailed Dataset exposures. It employs composition by nesting DatasetTableSerializer, implying an aggregate or parent-child domain relationship where a Dataset owns multiple DatasetTables. This design isolates API schema evolution from the underlying relational model, ensuring views remain thin and models remain persistence-focused. The serializer likely targets a detail view (as opposed to a list view), justifying the inclusion of rich nested data that would be too heavy for collection endpoints.
improvements: Explicitly declare the Meta class with model = Dataset and an explicit fields list to avoid over-exposure
Set read_only=True or depth constraints on the nested DatasetTableSerializer if write-through is not intended
Add select_related/prefetch_related hints in the view or override get_queryset to prevent N+1 queries when serializing nested tables
Introduce type hints and docstrings to clarify the expected shape of serialized data
Consider splitting into separate read and write serializers if the read schema significantly differs from the write schema (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)
